name: Noboru the Cudgel
summary: At the Harborage, the Draenei have endured Noboru the Cudgel’s torment for months. You carry his cudgel to their leader, a token of the cruelty the lost ones have dealt them.

sections.title: A Symbol of Brutality
sections.body: For months, Noboru has tormented the Draenei who live at the Harborage. His cudgel recalls the cruelty the lost ones have dealt them. You carry it to their leader.

sections.title: Magtoor's Welcome
sections.body: Magtoor asks whether the weapon means Noboru is dead. He calls it a day of joy for the Harborage. Noboru and his gang terrorized the Draenei as they wandered the swamps, killing anyone who crossed their path. Noboru threatened their very survival, and they lacked the strength to face him.

faq.answer: Noboru is one of the lost ones who has tormented the Harborage’s Draenei for months.

faq.q: Why does the Harborage want Noboru's cudgel?
faq.answer: The cudgel recalls the cruelty the lost ones have dealt the Draenei of the Harborage.
Magtoor, the leader of the Harborage, receives the cudgel.
The Harborage is in the Swamp of Sorrows, where its Draenei live.
